text: In the NARMA-10 lab, what happens when the ridge regularization is effectively removed (ridge_alpha ~ 0)?
choices: Lower training error but higher test error - a textbook case of overfitting
Lower test error, because regularization always hurts accuracy
No change, since the readout is linear either way
The reservoir loses the echo state property and becomes chaotic
explanation: Setting ridge_alpha ~ 0 makes the readout ordinary least squares, which typically fits the training set better but generalizes worse - higher test NMSE, the classic overfitting signature. Regularization does not always hurt, does change the linear solution, and does not affect the (fixed) reservoir dynamics.
